The company provides a no-code, AI-powered platform that enables organizations to build applications, automate workflows, collect operational data, and connect workers, machines, and enterprise systems within a unified environment. Its technology is used by manufacturers in industries such as pharmaceuticals, medical devices, aerospace, defense, and industrial manufacturing to replace paper-based processes and legacy operational systems with more flexible digital solutions. The platform allows frontline teams to create and deploy applications without extensive software development resources, supporting use cases such as work instructions, production tracking, quality management, equipment monitoring, electronic batch records, traceability, and compliance management. Tulip combines no-code application development with machine connectivity, analytics, and workflow automation, enabling manufacturers to adapt operational processes as requirements evolve. Tulip also provides connectivity tools that integrate data from machines, sensors, industrial equipment, ERP systems, and other enterprise applications. By serving as an operational data hub, the platform helps organizations gain real-time visibility into production activities, automate data collection, and generate insights that support process optimization and decision-making.

long_description: Ubicquia, Inc. is an intelligent infrastructure company founded in 2014 and based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The company specializes in transforming existing infrastructure, such as streetlights and utility poles, into connected, data-driven assets using AI, sensors, and advanced analytics. Ubicquia operates internationally, with a presence in Canada and serves businesses in the B2B space across high-tech, energy-tech, and environment-tech sectors. Ubicquia offers a range of smart city and utility solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing infrastructure. Their products include UbiCell, a plug-and-play IoT router for smart lighting; UbiHub, a gigabit switch for smart city networks; UbiGrid, which enhances grid resilience; and UbiVu®, an AI-driven analytics platform. These solutions help municipalities and utilities reduce energy waste, extend asset life, and lower carbon emissions. Ubicquia primarily targets municipalities, utilities, and mobile operators, with deployments in over 800 cities and major enterprises across North America.
